focus: Hardened Ubuntu EC2 environments via Terraform, engineered secure application networking with Route 53 & Cloudflare, and sustained 99.9% uptime with PM2 clustering.
highlights: Engineered secure application networking across AWS Route 53, Cloudflare, and AWS Security Groups, managing DNS routing, SSL/TLS termination, and origin server access restriction.
Provisioned and configured AWS EC2 (Ubuntu) production hosting environments using Terraform, managing server hardening and process dependencies.
Engineered zero-downtime CI/CD via GitHub Actions and PM2 clustering, sustaining 99.9% uptime across 15+ services.
Tuned Nginx reverse proxies for WebSocket upgrades and request routing; centralized AWS account access via AWS Organizations and IAM Identity Center (SSO).
